Subject: MAP: Azure Marketplace Private Offer — HelioZen Therapeutics (next steps & billing path)

Hi Amrita —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MPA) tailored for the Azure Marketplace private offer route. High-level asks here:

- Confirm procurement contact (I used procurement@heliozen.com and Thomas Reed as backup).
- Confirm target contract value and initial commit (I put $250k ARR as discussed; please update).
- Confirm preferred invoicing flow: (A) HelioZen pays invoice raised by Redwood, or (B) HelioZen accepts Azure private-offer invoice and pays via Azure billing.

What I'm proposing in the MAP (attached):
1) Technical acceptance window: 10 business days after access to private offer + test dataset.
2) Security/compliance sign-off: SOC2 evidence & IP policy — Redwood provides on sign-off step.
3) Contract/PO: DocuSign SOW + Azure PO acceptance (we'll provide the offer id to Azure to create the private offer).
4) Billing path: we can invoice directly (Redwood invoice to AP@heliozen.com) or flow through Azure — whichever your procurement prefers.
5) Kickoff: scheduled within 5 business days after PO & DocuSign sign.

Next steps for your team: review the attached MAP sheet, confirm procurement contact and preferred billing path, and let me know whether legal wants a tracked redline on the SOW or a brief summary.

If it helps we can do a 30-minute sync tomorrow morning (10–11am PT) to walk the plan and dates.

Attachments: 20261028-heliozen-mpa-draft.xlsx (MAP timeline + owners).

Best,
Markus
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Markus — thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP.

We reviewed the draft with the procurement team. A few notes up front:
- Procurement contact is procurement@heliozen.com (lead: Thomas Reed).
- Finance prefers option B (run through Azure billing) if possible — it simplifies centroiding for us, though we understand Azure will require the private-offer acceptance first.
- Legal will need to review your SOW and the marketplace T&Cs; please route the DocuSign to legal@heliozen.com and cc procurement.

Two questions:
1) Can you confirm whether the Azure private offer acceptance needs to happen before DocuSign, or can they be parallel?
2) For technical acceptance, our integration team will need the model endpoint under a test tenant and sample tokens — can you provide expected SLAs/latency baselines for the test environment?

I'll coordinate with Thomas to propose internal stakeholders for the MAP owners column and come back with a PO number as soon as legal signs off.

Thanks —
Amrita
Director, Product Ops
HelioZen Therapeutics

Amrita — quick answers and an updated owner timeline baked into the MAP (see revised sheet).

1) Azure private offer acceptance vs DocuSign: they can be parallel, but practical handoffs differ depending on billing path. If HelioZen wants Azure to invoice, the marketplace private-offer must be accepted in Azure (Samir at Azure creates the offer using the offer id we provide). DocuSign SOW can be routed in parallel — we typically have legal execute the SOW while Azure processes the private-offer acceptance. We'll coordinate the final step: Azure marks the offer accepted and that triggers the private SKU availability.

2) Test environment SLAs for evaluation: for the MAP test tenant we guarantee 95th percentile latency baselines of <450ms for requests <=512 tokens and throughput suitable for a 5-user evaluation load (continuous integration batch mode). We're happy to provide a short runbook for test dataset loading and an endpoint token. Jordan will own provisioning and the temporary billing allocation for the eval phase.

Proposed MAP milestones (dates are suggested):
- 10/29: HelioZen confirms procurement contact + billing preference (Amrita / Thomas)
- 10/30: Legal receives DocuSign package (Redwood sends)
- 11/02: Azure private-offer submitted to Samir/Azure by Redwood
- 11/03–11/16: 10-business-day technical acceptance window (provisioned test tenant on 11/03)
- 11/17: Production SLA start if acceptance completed

Action items for Redwood: send DocuSign SOW to legal@heliozen.com (Kimberly will attach redline guidance), provide offer id to Samir at Azure, provision test tenant on 11/03.

Action items for HelioZen: route PO or accept via Azure private-offer and confirm billing target.

I've also enabled a provisional invoice path in the MAP sheet for both options — please flag your preference so we can lock billing gates.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67231 
DocuSign (draft): https://www.docusign.com/embedded-sign/edf3-heliozen
Azure contact: Samir Patel <samir.patel@azuremarketplace.com>

Regards,
Markus

Quick note from legal on the SOW packaging: we should route the DocuSign envelope to legal@heliozen.com with the following fields for acceptance only (no immediate countersign) so HelioZen can review and return.
